title: Weekend at the lake
message: Here's the recap from last weekend!

items.title: Weekend at the lake
items.markdown:
We finally made it up to the cabin. The water was **cold** but clear, and the trail on the north side is open again.

## What worked
- Leaving at 7 to beat traffic
- The new stove (boils in 4 minutes)
- Packing one bag per person

## Next time
Bring the *second* paddle, and book the dock spot early. The general store closes at 6.

> “Best sunset of the summer.” — everyone, every night
